milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The dispenser is at spawn-relative (0, 1, 3). max_distance reduced to 5 (from 16) to prevent auto-completion at spawn — the player must walk forward a few steps to get within 5 blocks and face the dispenser. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The white stained glass panes are at z=7 and z=9 on both corridor walls. Target is the center of the first pair at (0, 1, 7). max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable corridor distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the glass panes. The player must progress past the dispenser to be facing this direction.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The birch trapdoor is at spawn-relative (0, 0, 13) at the end of the corridor, marking the cave entrance. max_distance=8 ensures the player has progressed well past the glass pane section (z=7-9) before this triggers. facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward/down at the trapdoor.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block', object='torch') because lighting up a cave requires placing torch blocks inside it. Changed from 'wall_torch' to 'torch' per CommonSenseAgent feedback — when a player descends the ladder and reaches the cave floor (y=-6), the most natural action is to place torches on the floor, which creates 'torch' blocks (not 'wall_torch'). The generous box from (-3,-7,13) to (3,-1,20) encompasses the entire cave interior and shaft area. min_count=1 means at least one torch must be placed to consider the cave 'lit up'.
